title: Retire the dead "passed" comparisons
description: verdictFrom counts contracts whose status is the literal "passed", which no engine writes since the terminal-vocabulary spec. The counter is structurally always zero, so parts of its downgrade logic are unreachable for any run.

successCriteria.description: src/pge/runtime/interpreter.ts:728 and src/pge/runtime/commit.ts:539 no longer compare against a status literal no writer produces; they use the settled predicate.
The downgrade paths that were unreachable are shown to be reachable again — a test drives success-with-failures to 'partial' and proves it fails before the change.
The status-vocabulary invariant scan's allowlist loses the entries these sites occupied, rather than keeping stale ones.
Golden cases whose artifacts move are re-captured in this sprint, diff hunks read — this change alters verdicts, so movement is expected and must be understood.
Full suite, typecheck, typecheck:tests, lint and build green, and the golden gate passing at or above its replay floor.

nonGoals: Changing what a verdict MEANS — only which contracts are counted.
stopConditions: Making the counter live changes a golden case's verdict in a way that looks wrong rather than merely different — stop and understand it before re-capturing.
definitionOfDone: All required criteria met, the full suite plus typecheck, typecheck:tests, lint and build green, the golden gate passing, and every documentation claim added backed by a test that fails when the claim stops being true.
generatorNotes: Both sites are allowlisted with reasons in src/contracts/status-vocabulary.invariant.test.ts (around :205) — remove the entries as you migrate the sites, since a stale allowlist entry fails that test's own bidirectional check. isSettledContractStatus is the predicate. Expect real verdict movement: this is the sprint where previously-dead logic starts running. Run the suite as `npx vitest run --exclude '**/.claude/worktrees/**' --exclude '**/node_modules/**'` — a bare run picks up nested worktrees. Verify on a CLEAN checkout, not just the working tree: this repo has twice been green locally and red in CI because uncommitted state was carrying the result.
evaluatorNotes: Verify the reachability claim by execution, not by reading: construct a run with successes and failures and confirm the verdict is now 'partial' where it used to be 'failed'.
